maxPressure.sourceNote: The cited article gives 60,191 psi by NATO EPVAT, which is 415.0 MPa — exactly the C.I.P. figure for the .308 Winchester, so the number appears to be a conversion of it rather than an independent measurement. STANAG 2310 is not free.
